items.title: Joe Ascione interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clearwater Beach, Florida, March 17, 2001
items.q: Yes he was. He was earlier. But it was great.

ctx.x: Yeah. It was a little after the time I was thinking of, but Menza was earlier of course.

Yes he was. He was earlier. But it was great. It was great to hear that night after night. And I never talked drums with him, because it just — I’m fairly intuitive so there’s a barometer, you can tell what the boundaries are. But I would observe, especially behind the instrument. But we played softball with the guys. Or he used to like to eat Creamsicles. So we’d stop at a town and I’d go to a deli and buy a whole box of Creamsicles. He’d take a big bite with those capped teeth, you remember stupid things. You’d…
I’ve heard people say that he had extreme, could be extremely nice and then could be extremely not nice. Did you ever witness either one of those things?
